description: This Java class 'CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor' is a deprecated visitor implementation that traverses policy tree nodes to collect subject IDs affected by permission changes, evaluating permissions at resource nodes and aggregating results.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A deprecated visitor class that collects subject IDs affected by permission changes within a policy tree.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating permissions for a specific subject ID at resource nodes.

methods.name: CollectEffectedSubjectIdsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a policy tree node, delegating to subject or resource node handlers.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles subject nodes, creating evaluators for each subject ID.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles resource nodes, aggregating permissions for evaluation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the collected EffectedSubjectIds after traversal.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Aggregates permissions from a resource node for a specific subject.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Determines the position of a resource node relative to the target pointer.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates permissions to determine if subject IDs are granted or revoked.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyRevoked
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively revoked based on weights.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyGranted
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively granted based on weights.
